The purpose of the "now" page is to tell you what I'm working on or thinking
about right now. The idea comes from [Derek Sivers](https://nownownow.com/about).

## Projects

**T Cell Engagers.** Supporting drug development and dose selection of T cell
engagers in oncology and immunology indications.

**GenAI.** TrinityMetrics: exploring agentic coding with GitHub Copilot and
Positron, focused on supporting clinical PK/PD analysis in restricted
environments where agents cannot be given direct access to sensitive clinical
data.
